Notes: According to YG, the track came together in 2009 after Ty invited him to the his home studio to jump on a track he and his friends were working on. According to Ty, this was before it was a YG song and it had a feature from his cousin, TeeCee4800, which was cut for release. He also stated that this version had a music video shot for it by James Earl Jones III, meaning it was likely finished. In an interview with The FADER, Ty said, "...I made [the Toot It and Boot It] beat in 5 minutes, made the hook in 10 minutes, [then] YG came and did his part". This version was found on Youtube in low quality, alongside a music video. A version featuring TeeCee's verse was also released on YG's mixtape The Real 4Fingaz.
